explanation: This is 0 everywhere except at the GO step right after a trial that reached S2 and paid no reward: it is high (8-10) when that trial was a rare a1 -> S2 and the agent chooses a1 again. It is moderate (2-6) after an unrewarded common a2 -> S2, higher when the agent switches to a1, and it stays 0 after unrewarded trials that reached S1 or after any rewarded trial.
